benefits.claim: The product provides improved project visibility and robust tracking capabilities, allowing users to know who is doing what and by when.
The product enhances team collaboration and communication by centralizing updates, comments, and files.
The product streamlines workflows and increases productivity by organizing tasks and operations efficiently.

frictions.claim: The interface can be overwhelming or cumbersome due to the multitude of features and options.
Users may receive an excessive number of unnecessary email notifications.
Tracking lengthy discussion threads can be difficult, leading to loss of context.

unknowns: The advanced capabilities of AI Teammates and agentic work management, including shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph, as distinct from general task scheduling.
The product's extensive ecosystem of integrations with other popular business applications.
Specific resource management capabilities like capacity planning and workload balancing.
